# Copperbeech Hosting - incident register

appear as an extra identical row each.

turns.prompt: Copperbeech is writing the September reliability note. How many incidents did we record in September in total? Just the number.
For the customer-facing note those numbers sweep in staging - drop the staging environment and recount September incidents. The bare number, please.
Which component had the most production incidents that month?
